lab.title: FTA / RBD visual lab
lab.equipHint: Active asset is selected in the RAMS sidebar
lab.needModel: Create or select a model first.

and.title: AND gate
and.desc: Output fault occurs only if all input faults occur (logical intersection).

or.title: OR gate
or.desc: Output fault occurs if any input fault occurs (logical union).

be.title: Basic event
be.desc: Primary initiating event or component failure with probability P (and derived λ, U over reference interval τ).

block.title: Reliability block
block.desc: Element with reliability R; unavailability U and failure rate λ are shown for the reference interval τ.

series.title: Series structure
series.desc: All subsystems must work; combined reliability is the product of component reliabilities.

parallel.title: Parallel structure
parallel.desc: Redundant paths; system works if at least one path works (1−Π(1−Ri)).

advanced.title: Advanced methods
advanced.heatmapTitle: FMECA severity × occurrence matrix (failure mode counts)
advanced.heatmapHint: Counts are aggregated from all FMECA analyses for the selected asset. Click a cell to filter the table to that (S, O) pair.
advanced.filterHint: Click a cell to filter rows
advanced.referenceStats: Published WORK.FAILURE_MODES: {{published}} · Linked FMECA modes: {{linked}} · Orphan links: {{orphaned}}
advanced.noRows: No FMECA rows for this filter. Create analyses and items in Asset foundation, or adjust the equipment id.
advanced.invNoWo: No linked work order for spare check
advanced.markovHint: Create, save, and evaluate a discrete Markov chain to feed the dashboard steady-state panel.
advanced.markovPermission: ram.analyze permission is required to create or evaluate Markov models.
advanced.markovNone: No Markov model for this equipment.

governance.title: Governance
governance.body: Ishikawa (fishbone) RCA diagrams are persisted per asset. Add causes under each 6M branch, save, and compare multiple assets when needed.
governance.promoteBody: Creates a traceable link to this Ishikawa diagram. Save the diagram first if you have not already.
governance.promoteNeedSave: Save the diagram before promoting a cause.
governance.promoteNeedUser: You must be signed in to create a work order.
governance.promoteSuccessWo: Work order created from RCA cause.
governance.promoteSuccessFmeca: FMECA row created from the root cause.
governance.unreadable: The saved diagram cannot be read. It is kept as stored; nothing is saved over it.
governance.promoteFmecaHint: The study's FMECA form opens with this cause: choose the failure mode and rate severity, occurrence and detection.
governance.unsavedBody: Moves, links or deletions on the root-cause diagram are not saved yet. They are lost if you leave.

foundation.title: Asset foundation
foundation.hint: Taxonomy, exposure, KPI jobs, and data quality drill-throughs.
foundation.kpiRefreshDone: KPI snapshot refreshed ({{events}} events, {{hours}} h exposure).

questions.on_condition_feasible: Is an on-condition task feasible (detectable warning before failure) and worth doing?

questions.scheduled_discard_feasible: Is scheduled discard feasible and worth doing?

rcmLoop.justification: Justification (required when different from the recommendation)

rcmLoop.noEvidence: No failure history for this mode: enter α and λp.

kpi.clickRowHint: Click a row to reload the snapshot and display the chart.

weibull.title: Weibull — fit (inter-arrival times)
weibull.hint: PRD 6.10.4 — 2-parameter MLE; asymptotic intervals if the sample is sufficient.
weibull.empty: No result — run a fit on failure events.

fmeca.hint: PRD 6.10.5 — CRUD for analyses and rows; RPN = S×O×D (1–10). Write:
fmeca.selectPrompt: Select an analysis in the table to edit its rows.

rcm.title: RCM — PM-linked decisions
rcm.selectPrompt: Select a study to manage RCM decisions.

graphModels.title: FTA / RBD / event tree (PRD 6.10)
graphModels.hint: Local graph models — FTA (AND/OR + top prob.), RBD (series/parallel), ETA (sequence).

advancedModels.title: Monte Carlo, Markov, guardrails
advancedModels.hint: MC: trials + reproducible seed; Markov: discrete-time chain (matrix powers). Guardrails: method limits and enablement.

dataQuality.title: RAM data quality
dataQuality.hint: Badges (green if score ≥ 0.85 and no blocking code). Drill-through: WOs without failure mode, equipment without exposure in 90 days.

shell.title: Reliability (RAMS) — failure taxonomy
shell.description: PRD 6.10.1 — ISO 14224 hierarchies and codes (local preview).

ramAssumptions.title: Assumptions by method (advanced RAM)
ramAssumptions.disclaimer: Local summary for review — does not replace the applicable standard or business validation.

weibull.title: Weibull
weibull.line1: Events independent in time; i.i.d. inter-arrival times for the fit.

fmeca.title: FMECA
fmeca.line1: S, O, D on a 1–10 scale; RPN = S×O×D; no explicit correlation between factors.

fta.title: FTA
fta.line1: AND/OR gates; independent probabilities between inputs; no common-cause dependencies modelled.

rbd.title: RBD
rbd.line1: Independent blocks; series = product of reliabilities; parallel = 1−Π(1−Ri).

eta.title: Event tree
eta.line1: Directed graph without recombination (typical usage); conditional branch probabilities given.

mc.title: Monte Carlo
mc.line1: Sampling with a fixed seed for reproducibility; uniform bounds and Bernoulli supported.

markov.title: Markov (DTMC)
markov.line1: Time-homogeneous discrete chain; stochastic matrix; steady state by iteration.

visualLab.stencilDesktopHint: Use the symbol library in desktop mode (X6 stencil).
visualLab.emptyCanvasFta: FTA empty canvas — create a model to begin.

kpi.failuresHint: {{hours}} h of downtime in the period

fleet.basisMixed: operating hours ({{operating}} eq.) and calendar hours ({{calendar}} eq.)
fleet.selectFirst: Tick at least one equipment in the table
fleet.badActorsHint: Ranked by downtime hours in the period. Tick the equipment to study together (same class: their failure data are pooled), then “Study”.
fleet.mixedClassesBody: Pooling failures only makes sense for similar equipment in the same duty. Check the selection before opening the study.
fleet.emptyBody: No closed corrective or emergency work order recorded a failure for these filters. Widen the period or change the site or class.
fleet.handedError: The equipment handed over could not be loaded

studies.title: Saved studies
studies.hint: A study keeps its scope, the excluded records with their reason, the costs and the decisions.
studies.empty: No study yet. Tick equipment above to open one.
studies.archiveConfirm: Study “{{title}}” will no longer be listed. Its records, costs and decisions are kept.

study.title: Study: {{title}}
study.periodOrder: The period must start before it ends.

data.title: Failures and suspensions
data.hint: Built from the failures of closed corrective work orders and from preventive replacements. Untick a row to exclude it from every analysis (the reason is kept in the study history). A suspension is a part removed before failure or still in service: it counts as survival time.
data.emptyBody: This equipment has no failure for this mode in the period. Widen the period or remove the mode filter.

kindHint.end_of_period: In service at the end of the period
kindHint.competing_mode: Failure of another mode: the part was renewed

reason.not_eligible: Excluded by default: no mode or cause not determined
reason.no_known_start: Age unknown: no earlier renewal known (its repair starts the next age)
reason.zero_age: Zero age: no operating hours since the previous renewal
reason.pm_not_confirmed: To confirm: did this preventive work replace the part?

data.checksHint: What changes the result, with a direct link to correct it.
data.excludeBody: {{record}} will no longer be used in the analyses of this study. The reason is kept in the history.

cause_missing.title: {{wo}}: cause not coded
cause_missing.body: The mode is coded without the ISO 14224 cause or mechanism.

mode_missing.title: {{wo}}: failure mode missing
mode_missing.body: Without a mode the failure cannot be tied to the study; it is excluded by default.

operating_hours_low.title: {{asset}}: operating hours incomplete
operating_hours_low.body: Readings only cover {{coverage}} % of the period; ages outside the readings are underestimated.

no_operating_hours.title: {{asset}}: no operating hours
no_operating_hours.body: No hour meter or operating schedule: the study counts calendar hours.

pm_to_confirm.title: Preventive replacements to confirm
pm_to_confirm.body: {{count}} preventive work order(s) in the period. Tick those that replaced the part: they then count as suspensions.

no_known_start.title: Unknown ages
no_known_start.body: {{count}} failure(s) without a known renewal before them: not used.

mechanism_missing.title: {{wo}}: mechanism not coded
mechanism_missing.body: Mode and cause are coded without the ISO 14224 mechanism.

not_enough_failures.title: Not enough failures
not_enough_failures.body: A life analysis needs at least {{min}} failures in use (currently {{count}}). Widen the period, add similar equipment or correct the data in step 1.

no_finite_mle.title: Fit not possible
no_finite_mle.body: The ages do not allow a Weibull estimate (for example every failure at the same age). Check the data in step 1.

no_covariance.title: Confidence bounds not possible
no_covariance.body: The fit gives no valid information matrix for these data. Check the data in step 1.

life.plotHint: Each point is a failure, placed at its age and median rank (suspensions accounted for). Points close to the line: the Weibull model fits. Band: 90 % confidence (Fisher matrix).

early_life.title: Early-life failures (β < 1)
early_life.body: Failures come early: installation, part quality or start-up. Age-based replacement would make it worse; treat the cause.

random.title: Random failures (β ≈ 1)
random.body: At 90 % confidence the risk does not clearly change with age. Scheduled replacement does not help; prefer condition monitoring.

wear_out.title: Wear-out (β > 1)
wear_out.body: Risk grows with age. Planned replacement before wear-out works, ideally with condition monitoring.

life.median: Half of these parts fail before {{median}} {{unit}}.
life.pmAfterMedian: Plan {{plan}} replaces them at {{interval}} h, after half of the failures.
life.pmBeforeMedian: Plan {{plan}} replaces them at {{interval}} h, before the median.
life.noPm: No interval PM plan targets this equipment.

method.mle: 2-parameter Weibull, maximum likelihood with suspensions (right-censored data).
method.operating: Ages in operating hours since the previous renewal (hour meter or operating schedule).
method.calendar: Ages in calendar hours since the previous renewal: not every equipment has operating-hours data.
method.renewal: Each repair renews the part; an excluded record is ignored.
method.pooled_other: {{count}} equipment pooled (same class and duty assumed).
method.bounds: 90 % bounds from the Fisher matrix (asymptotic approximation).
method.small: Fewer than 10 failures: wide confidence interval, treat as a starting point.

life.curveTitle: Reliability and failure rate by age
life.curveHint: R(t): probability the part still works at age t. h(t): risk of failure per hour at that age.
life.recomputeError: The analysis could not be recomputed: the figures shown are from the last successful calculation

cost.title: Optimal replacement interval
cost.hint: Age-replacement model: mean cost per hour by preventive replacement age.

intervalNote.not_hours_meter: meter is not an hour meter

source.missing: Enter both costs: there is no default for this class.

cost.enterCosts: Enter the cost of a planned replacement and of a breakdown to compute the interval.
cost.chartTitle: Cost per hour by replacement age

memo.title: Decision note for management
memo.proposeVsCurrent: Replace the part of {{assets}} every {{interval}} {{unit}} instead of {{current}} h today.
memo.assumptions_one: Assumptions: planned replacement {{planned}}, breakdown {{failure}} (lost production included), {{hpy}} {{unit}} per year for the equipment, from its data.
memo.assumptions_other: Assumptions: planned replacement {{planned}}, breakdown {{failure}} (lost production included), {{hpy}} {{unit}} per year for the {{count}} equipment, from their data.

noInterval.no_wear_out: Without clear wear-out (β ≤ 1), scheduled replacement does not lower the cost per hour. Keep condition monitoring and review the study after the next failures.
noInterval.failure_not_costlier: A breakdown costs no more than a planned replacement: replacing before failure saves nothing.
noInterval.no_benefit: The best interval saves less than 1 % against running to failure.
noInterval.invalid_input: The costs entered are not valid.

fmeca.title: FMECA
fmeca.body: The study FMECA worksheet (ISO 14224 modes of the class, severity, occurrence from the life analysis, detection) will be built into this step.
fmeca.today: Meanwhile, the current FMECA screen shows the criticality matrix and the modes of this equipment.

rcm.title: RCM decision
rcm.body: The SAE JA1011 decision logic, prefilled from the FMECA and the life analysis, will be built into this step.
rcm.today: Meanwhile, record the decision directly in step 6: the study evidence is attached automatically.

system.title: System model
system.body: The reliability block diagram and fault tree fed by the study will be built into this step.
system.today: Meanwhile, the current modelling workshop remains available for this equipment.

decision.dialogHint: It joins the decision log with the study evidence and, once approved, creates the change in maintenance.
decision.title: Decision

kinds.pm_interval: New version of a PM plan (change the interval)

decision.noPlans: No interval PM plan targets this equipment: choose a work order.
decision.loadError: The plans, work-order types or approvers could not be loaded

decisions.title: Decision log
decisions.hint: Each recommendation with its evidence, its approval, what it created in maintenance and its measured effect on MTBF.
decisions.emptyBody: Record a decision from the step 2 note or with the “Record a decision” button.
decisions.effectDetail: MTBF before {{before}} h, since the decision {{after}} h ({{failures}} failure(s))
decisions.ownProposal: You proposed it: another person approves.
decisions.applyPm: A new draft version of plan {{plan}} is created with the new interval. It is published through the normal PM review.
decisions.applyWo: A work order is created on {{asset}}, linked to this decision.
decisions.approveBody: "{{title}}" becomes approved and can then be applied (PM revision or work order).
decisions.selfApprovedHint: Approved by the person who proposed it.

fmeca.title: FMECA: {{classes}}
fmeca.hint: ISO 14224 failure modes recorded on this equipment and its class. Severity, occurrence and detection on the plant 1–10 grids (hover a rating for its definition). The occurrence is proposed from the data, with its basis.
fmeca.emptyBody: Add the modes proposed on the right or another mode from the ISO 14224 list.
fmeca.deleteBlocked: An RCM decision or a study decision relies on this row.
fmeca.deleteConfirm: Row “{{mode}}” will be removed from the study FMECA.
fmeca.matrixHint: Severity and occurrence in classes 1 to {{classes}}. Colour: plant risk zones; the number counts the modes in each cell.
fmeca.proposalsHint: Recorded in the work orders of this equipment (period) and its class (history).
fmeca.noProposals: Every observed mode is already in the FMECA.
fmeca.proposalCounts: {{period}} in the period · {{classCount}} on the class
fmeca.basisWeibull: {{rate}} failure(s) per equipment-year from the life analysis (MTTF {{mttf}} h, {{hours}} operating h per year)
fmeca.dialogAdd: Add a mode to the FMECA
fmeca.dialogHint: Each rating reads on the plant grid. The proposed occurrence comes from the data; you can change it.
fmeca.noProposal: No failure of this mode is recorded: rate the occurrence from the grid.
fmeca.rpnMissing: Rate severity, occurrence and detection to compute the RPN.
fmeca.rootCauseHint: Cause diagram per equipment: add causes under each branch, save, and turn a cause into a work order or an FMECA row.
fmeca.toReviewHint: Ratings were not chosen by a person (former automatic entry). Open the row, rate it and save: until then it is not counted.
fmeca.rowsToReviewBody: Their ratings were set automatically, not chosen. They stay listed but are left out of the matrix, the RPN ranking, RCM and decisions until they are rated and saved.
fmeca.fromRootCauseBody: Cause: {{cause}}. Choose the failure mode and rate the row; nothing is preset.

scales.title: Plant rating grids
scales.hint: Definition of each rating. Severity carries the RCM consequence class, occurrence the number of failures per equipment-year, detection whether the failure is hidden.
scales.plantWide: These grids are shared by every FMECA study of the plant: a change here applies to all studies, not only this one.
scales.thresholdInvalid: Each occurrence threshold must be a number of 0 or more (decimals allowed).
scales.loadError: The FMECA rating grids could not be loaded
scales.hostHint: Definitions of the FMECA ratings used by every study of the plant. Scores (1–10) and zones are fixed; their definitions and attributes are the plant's.
scales.whoEdits: Edited by holders of the reliability manage right (ram.manage).
scales.readOnly: Read only: editing needs the reliability manage right (ram.manage).
scales.managedInReference: These grids are edited in Données de référence › Échelles AMDEC.
scales.reviewFormerUnreadable: To review: the former rating grids could not be read, so the Maintafox grids are in place. Check each grid and save it.
scales.substituteTitle: Maintafox grids in place, plant grids to review
scales.substituteBody: The plant's rating grids could not be read, so ratings, RPN, risk zones and RCM consequences here use the Maintafox grids. Ask a reliability manager to review and save the grids in Données de référence › Échelles AMDEC before relying on this ranking.

rcm.emptyBody: The RCM decision starts from the FMECA rows: add the modes in step 3 first.
rcm.title: RCM decision: {{mode}}
rcm.hint: SAE JA1011 decision logic, one failure mode at a time. Answers pre-filled from the FMECA and the life analysis, editable.

failure_evident.text: Will the loss of function be evident to operators under normal circumstances?

safety_or_environmental.text: Could it hurt someone or breach an environmental limit?

operational_impact.text: Does it affect output, quality or customer service?

multiple_failure_affects_safety.text: Would the multiple failure (with the protected function) have safety consequences?

on_condition_feasible.text: Is an on-condition task feasible and worth doing? (detectable P-F interval)

scheduled_restoration_feasible.text: Is scheduled restoration feasible? (clear wear-out, β > 1)

scheduled_discard_feasible.text: Is scheduled discard feasible and worth doing?

failure_finding_feasible.text: Is a failure-finding test feasible and worth doing?

combination_feasible.text: Does a combination of tasks bring the risk to a tolerable level?

basis.detection: From detection: rating {{score}} of the grid.
basis.severity: From severity: rating {{score}} of the grid.
basis.weibull_wear_out: From the life analysis: clear wear-out (β = {{value}}).
basis.weibull_no_wear_out: From the life analysis: no clear wear-out (β = {{value}}).
basis.no_fit: No life analysis for this mode: to be judged.
basis.pf_unknown: P-F interval unknown: give it if there is a measurable warning sign.
basis.analyst: To be judged by the analyst.

tacticBody.condition_based: Monitor the warning sign every {{inspection}} {{unit}} (half the P-F interval) and act before the failure.
tacticBody.time_based: Replace or restore the part at a fixed age; economic interval from step 2: {{replacement}} {{unit}}.
tacticBody.failure_finding: Test the hidden function periodically to find the failure before it is called upon.
tacticBody.run_to_failure: No proactive task is justified: repair on failure.
tacticBody.redesign: No task brings the risk to a tolerable level: modify the installation.

rcm.redesignCompulsory: Redesign is compulsory (safety or environmental risk).
rcm.noFitNote: This mode is not the one of the life analysis: the age questions are to be judged.
rcm.justification: Justification (required when it differs from the recommendation)
rcm.noTask: Run to failure: no action to create.
rcm.rowsToReviewBody: Rate them in the FMECA step to analyse them here.
rcm.previewError: The recommendation could not be recomputed: the one shown may be out of date, saving waits

system.missionNeeded: Give the mission time to compute the model.
system.saveIncomplete: Complete the model (see the points listed) before saving it.
system.noRbdBody: Start from the study equipment (in parallel, to adjust) or from an empty model.
system.noFtaBody: Create the top event, then add gates and basic events.
system.rbdHint: Select a block or a branch to edit its structure and the source of its reliability; the results update.
system.pickNodeHint: Select an element of the diagram.
system.label: Name
system.kLabel: Number of elements that must work (out of {{n}})
system.systemRHint: probability of working the whole mission
system.birnbaumHint: Gain in system reliability if this block became perfect
system.criticalityHint: Share of the system unreliability due to this block
system.ftaHint: Named events, probability or rate from the study or typed; the top event is chosen by its name.
system.unreachable: This element is not linked to the top event.

method.exact_inclusion_exclusion: exact calculation over the minimal cut sets

system.fvHint: Fussell-Vesely: share of the risk removed if the event is eliminated
system.rawHint: Risk achievement worth: risk multiplier if the event is certain

issue.missing_node: A referenced element does not exist ({{node}}).
issue.no_fit: {{node}}: the study has no life analysis.
issue.no_failures: {{node}}: no failure recorded, the MTBF is unknown.
issue.wrong_source: {{node}}: the top event must be a gate.
issue.needs_life_distribution: {{node}}: the simulation needs a life distribution (not a typed reliability).

system.evalError: The model could not be evaluated

markov.title: Markov chain
markov.hint: Availability of a repairable system with degraded states: states and rates (λ, μ per hour) in a table.

simulation.title: Monte Carlo simulation
simulation.hint: Availability and cost over the mission with uncertainty, simulated on the study reliability block diagram.
simulation.needRbd: Build the reliability block diagram and give the mission time first.
simulation.downtimeCost: Cost of one hour of downtime
simulation.method: Each block follows its life distribution, is repaired in an exponential time of mean MTTR and restarts as new; mission of {{hours}} h.
simulation.reliabilityHint: share of trials without a system stop
simulation.footer: {{trials}} trials, seed {{seed}}: the same calculation gives the same result.

event_tree.title: Event tree
event_tree.hint: Consequences of an initiating event depending on the barriers: success / failure branches with probabilities, frequency of the consequences.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.completeHint: {{complete}} of {{total}} with mode, cause and mechanism
quality.codingHint: Closed corrective work orders without an ISO 14224 mode, cause or mechanism: they leave the analyses or weaken them.
quality.noCodingGap: Every failure of the period is coded.
quality.hoursHint: Without an hour meter or operating schedule, studies count calendar hours.
quality.noHoursGap: Every failing equipment has operating hours.
quality.hoursDialogHint: Operating hours accumulated since the previous reading, at the given date.
quality.reviewHint: Samples too small for the indicators, insufficient inspection coverage.

issue.LOW_SAMPLE: Indicator computed on fewer than 5 failures or with data quality below 85 %.

quality.dismissBody: "{{issue}}" on {{asset}} will no longer be listed. Dismiss it only when the data is right as it is.
quality.truncated: Only the first ones are listed: fix these, then refresh to see the next.

errors.DECISION_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for the rejection.
errors.DECISION_STALE: The decision was changed by someone else. Reload it and try again.
errors.DECISION_TITLE_REQUIRED: Enter a title for the decision.
errors.DECISION_TRIGGER_MISSING: The proposed PM trigger is missing from this decision.
errors.DECISION_WO_TYPE_UNKNOWN: This work order type does not exist or is inactive.
errors.EVENT_TREE_BARRIERS: An event tree needs between 1 and the maximum number of barriers.
errors.EVENT_TREE_BARRIER_INVALID: Each barrier needs a name and a failure probability between 0 and 1.
errors.EVENT_TREE_FREQUENCY_INVALID: The initiating event frequency must be a positive number.
errors.EVENT_TREE_INVALID: The event tree could not be built from these inputs.
errors.FMECA_CAUSE_UNKNOWN: This failure cause is not in the reference list.
errors.FMECA_FAILURE_MODE_UNKNOWN: This failure mode is not in the reference list.
errors.FMECA_ITEM_HAS_DECISIONS: This FMECA row supports a recorded decision and cannot be deleted.
errors.FMECA_ITEM_NOT_IN_STUDY: This FMECA row does not belong to the study.
errors.FMECA_ITEM_REVIEW_REQUIRED: This FMECA row must be reviewed (real ratings) before it can be used.
errors.FMECA_MECHANISM_UNKNOWN: This failure mechanism is not in the reference list.
errors.FMECA_OCCURRENCE_SOURCE_INVALID: Unknown source for the occurrence rating.
errors.MARKOV_DUPLICATE_STATE: Two states have the same name.
errors.MARKOV_NEEDS_UP_AND_DOWN: The model needs at least one running state and one failed state.
errors.MARKOV_NOT_IRREDUCIBLE: Every state must be reachable from every other state.
errors.MARKOV_RATE_INVALID: Transition rates must be positive numbers.
errors.MARKOV_TOO_FEW_STATES: The model needs at least two states.
errors.MARKOV_TOO_MANY_STATES: The model has more states than allowed.
errors.MARKOV_UNKNOWN_STATE: A transition refers to a state that does not exist.
errors.RATING_SCALE_CONSEQUENCE: Each severity level needs a consequence class (safety, operational or non-operational).
errors.RATING_SCALE_DETECTION_HIDDEN: Each detection level must say whether the failure is hidden.
errors.RATING_SCALE_MATRIX: The criticality matrix needs 2 to 10 classes and at least one zone.
errors.RATING_SCALE_OCCURRENCE_THRESHOLDS: Occurrence thresholds must be positive and increase from one level to the next.
errors.RATING_SCALE_SETTING_INVALID: The stored rating scales cannot be read. Save the scales again.
errors.RCM_FMECA_ITEM_NOT_IN_STUDY: This FMECA row does not belong to the study.
errors.RCM_PF_INTERVAL_INVALID: The P-F interval must be a positive number.
errors.SIMULATION_MISSION_INVALID: The mission time must be a positive number.
errors.SIMULATION_TRIALS_INVALID: The number of trials is outside the allowed range.
errors.STUDY_ARCHIVED: This study is archived and can no longer be changed.
errors.STUDY_COMPETING_MODES_INVALID: Unknown treatment for the other failure modes.
errors.STUDY_COSTS_CURRENCY_MISSING: Choose the currency of the costs.
errors.STUDY_FAILURE_MODE_UNKNOWN: This failure mode is not in the reference list.
errors.STUDY_NO_ASSETS: Add at least one equipment to the study.
errors.STUDY_PERIOD_EMPTY: The end of the period must be after its start.
errors.STUDY_RECORD_KEY_INVALID: This record could not be identified.
errors.STUDY_RECORD_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for excluding or reclassifying this record.
errors.STUDY_STALE: The study was changed by someone else. Reload it and try again.
errors.STUDY_STATUS_INVALID: This status change is not allowed for the study.
errors.STUDY_TOO_MANY_ASSETS: The study has more equipment than allowed.
errors.SYSTEM_MISSION_INVALID: The mission time must be a positive number.
errors.SYSTEM_MODEL_INCOMPLETE: The system model is incomplete: fix the blocks flagged in the diagram.
errors.DECISION_NO_SECOND_APPROVER: Nobody else can approve this decision, and its site requires a second person (four-eyes). Ask an administrator to give the reliability approve right (ram.manage) to another person, or to allow self-approval for this site in Settings › General › Rules per site.
errors.DECISION_SELF_APPROVAL_SITE_UNKNOWN: Four-eyes applies: the site of this decision cannot be determined (an equipment has no planning site, or the study spans several sites). Another person must approve it.
errors.RATING_SCALE_SCORES: Each grid must rate every score from 1 to 10 exactly once.
errors.RATING_SCALE_LABEL: Every rating needs a definition in French and in English.
